offering_description.value: HireQuest helps employers fill temporary, contract, and permanent roles, from on-demand staffing to executive search. It delivers these services through a global network of franchised staffing and recruiting offices and offers franchise opportunities to business operators.

quotes.quote: HireQuest is a franchisor of staffing solutions with a presence across the U.S. and international markets. Through its primary divisions – HireQuest Direct, HireQuest Health, MRINetwork, Snelling, and TradeCorp – the company provides temporary, direct-hire, and contract staffing solutions across industries, including construction, light industrial, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and engineering. From on-demand staffing to executive search, HireQuest’s divisions operate as one team for our customers -delivering workforce solutions that drive growth and change lives. Our flourishing franchise owners are as diverse as the communities they serve, and include veterans, women, minorities, first-time business owners, and families. They are all just as dedicated as we are to helping individuals rejoin the workforce and supporting businesses as they scale.

HireQuest’s global network of franchised staffing and recruiting offices connects businesses with top talent across key industries and markets worldwide. Through our family of brands— HireQuest Direct, Snelling, TradeCorp, and MRINetwork —we deliver comprehensive workforce solutions, from reliable temporary and light industrial staffing to professional recruiting and executive search. Whether your organization operates in the U.S. or internationally, our expanding footprint ensures we can support your hiring needs wherever you do business. Explore our locations to find the right staffing and recruiting partner for your team.

quotes.quote: Our commitment extends to providing fair employment opportunities, professional development, and a safe, supportive workplace for all. We are committed to compliance with all federal and state law regarding equal employment opportunities and are actively involved in supporting local communities by partnering with organizations that promote workforce development, education, and social well-being.
Due to recent changes in federal law, we are now only required to furnish Form 1095-C upon request.
